inputs.text: A seamless-looking square flat-lay albedo texture of original stylized fantasy stone paving. Large readable hand-painted stone slabs and irregular cobbles with confident simplified shapes. Stylized blue-gray palette with restrained warm grey and pale stone variation. Low photographic noise and a clean painterly surface with subtle brush and chisel marks. Orthographic top-down albedo appearance with flat even illumination, no cast shadows and no perspective. Stone pattern fills the frame edge to edge with no border, frame, text, logo or watermark. Mid-frequency wear follows stone edges and contact points rather than uniform photographic grain. Original ruined-waystation stonework culture, not a copy of an existing game or recognizable asset. Intended Roblox use: Repeating floor surface in an original fantasy exploration game; flat albedo material only. Style direction: Adventure Fantasy. Weathered stone, woven fiber and oxidized metal with restrained hand-shaped variation. Surface detail rule: Mid-frequency wear follows edges and contact points, never uniform noise. Palette anchored in deep teal (#314D50), warm stone grey (#887B69), pale sand (#D5B888), with teal (#80B8AA) and orange (#D69B5C) accents. Lighting and material response: Warm directional sun against cool ambient recesses; entrances and objectives retain contrast. Tiling requirement: an edge-to-edge repeating texture with no visible border, frame or vignette. Blend repeated stone with decals or modular breakup; test 3x3 and long sightlines. This is a flat albedo material texture, not a scene mockup or a perspective render. Originality: Create a new culture and insignia; avoid named fantasy universes, borrowed maps or recognizable quest icons. Avoid recognizable existing games, brands, characters, logos, watermarks, readable text and copied compositions.
photographic noise, photorealistic gravel, perspective, horizon, cast shadows, objects, border, frame, text, letters, watermark, logo, recognizable game asset, copied composition
